text:
اس دنیا کے تن نام—
پرسی، پرسا، پرس رام۔
romanized:
Is dunyā ke tin nām—
Parsī, Parsā, Paras Rām.
literal_en:
In this world there are three ways of addressing a man.
Poor Parsī, respectable Parsā, honoured Paras Rām.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
